Re: Account reference: ACC-970357

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the statute of limitations for the above-referenced account. We understand that you have raised concerns about the validity of the debt and the alleged collection agency's actions.

We have reviewed the account information and confirm that the original creditor is Liberty Credit Corp. According to our records, the charge-off date for this account is 2024-03-05. We have also verified that there is no record of any payments made on this account.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. However, we have determined that the validation request is not applicable in this case, as the account has been charged off.

Regarding your dispute, we will investigate the matter and verify the accuracy of the information provided. We will also review our procedures to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

Please note that the Rhode Island General Laws, Chapter 9-26, govern debt collection practices in our state. We will conduct a thorough review of the account and respond to your concerns accordingly.

You have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe additional information is necessary to resolve the matter. Please contact us in writing if you wish to continue this dispute.

Sincerely,

Allied Recovery Services
